item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:50 HKT 30/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the central to northern part of the South China Sea will edge towards the coast of western Guangdong to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary gradually tomorrow. It will be windier with squally showers and thunderstorms over the region in the next couple of days. A southwesterly airstream will bring showers to the coastal areas on Sunday. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 31/05 (Friday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers and a few thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times later. There will be swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
